COMMAND.name: show auditd-system
COMMAND.help: Display settings and parameters for auditd, a kernel auditing application

COMMAND.name: show auditd-system rules
COMMAND.help: Display kernel audit rules for the auditd application

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Display kernel audit rules for the auditd application. It shows the selected profile and the list of rules configured in the kernel for this profile.
DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# show auditd-system rules ------------------------------------------------------------------------- Audit rules profile: basic ------------------------------------------------------------------------- -w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k session -w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k session sonic#

COMMAND.name: show auditd-system log
COMMAND.help: Display kernel audit log for the auditd application

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Display kernel audit log for the auditd application. By default it shows the last 20 lines of log.

COMMAND.name: auditd-system
COMMAND.help: Configure kernel audit settings specific to the auditd application

COMMAND.name: auditd-system rules
COMMAND.help: Configure kernel audit rules specific to the auditd application

PARAM.name: basic
PARAM.help: Rules to monitor sessions and package updates

PARAM.name: detail
PARAM.help: Rules to monitor sessions,packages,users,groups,cron jobs,kernel modules,configuration files

PARAM.name: custom
PARAM.help: Install custom rules. User to copy the rules file to config://auditd-custom.rules prior to executing this command

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Configure kernel audit rules specific to the auditd application. The rules are configured as a profile. Each profile defines a set of rules. These rules are configured in the kernel. Two profiles are available: basic and detail. The detail profile encompasses the basic rules along with additional ones.
DOCGEN.EXAMPLE: sonic# configure terminal sonic(config)# auditd-system rules detail

DOCGEN.DESCRIPTION: Delete all auditd specific rules from the kernel audit system.
